hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: Chalon, an extinct arguably distinct Northern Costanoan language, is missing from E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 (**hh:w:Heizer:Henshaw**, **hh:t:Shaul:Chalon-Rumsen**, **hh:hvb:Golla:California**, **hh:hew:Hale:Philology**, **hh:w:Heizer:Pinart**).

classification.sub: Chalon likely participates in a part of Holtzmann's law and links lexically to South Costanoan **hh:hvw:Callaghan:Utian**:14-18 (I wish to thank Mikhail Zhivlov for drawing my attention to the position of Chalon)
